content.text: I couldn't rotate the token because none of the available tools can manage account API tokens. The connected Cloudflare server only offers groups for Turnstile, Durable Objects, Email Sending and Routing, Workers, D1, KV, R2, Queues and Containers, and none of them covers the account API token endpoints.
